summary: Workers who spend their days in different homes discover through organizing that they live near each other.
realLife: Adams credited his union with helping him learn that three other home-care workers lived in his building.
gates: The workers share a building and an organization or event brings them together.
inGame: needs: an organizing contact linked to both workers’ residences.

turns.pulledBy: They want to keep in touch and have a common evening free.
turns.writesBack: A local gathering enters their calendars.

turns.pulledBy: Their shifts prevent meeting again soon.
turns.writesBack: The connection survives the first introduction.
